spans.s:
वण् वण् (also written बण्), cl. 1. P.
वणति, ववाण (Caus. Aor. अवीवणत् or
अववाणत्), वणितुम्, to sound.
वण, अस्, m. sound, noise.

वाण 1. वाण, अस्, आ, अम् (often written बाण,
q. v.; fr. rt. वण्, ‘to sound’), sounding (Kirāt.

XV.
10

. the Maruts
are described as वाणम् धमन्तः, ‘blowing on
their pipe’ or ‘playing on their lute,’ वाण being
explained by Sāy. as ‘a kind of lute with a hundred
strings’); a sound, voice; a word spoken, agreement
(Ved., Sāy. = वचन); a mark for arrows, aim; the
udder of a cow; alone, solitary (= केवल); N. of
an Asura (a son of Bali, an enemy of Viṣṇu, and
favourite of Śiva); of one of Skanda's attendants;
of a king; of a poet (the author of the Kādambarī,
of the Harṣa-carita, and perhaps also of the Ratnā-
valī); of a person (mentioned in Rāja-taraṅginī

); fire (?), lightning (?); (अस्, आ), m. f. a blue-
flowering Barleria; the hind part or feathered end
of an arrow; (ई), f. sound, speech, (कठोरा वाणी,
a harsh speech); voice; praise, laudation; a literary
production; N. of Sarasvatī (the goddess of speech
[]
and eloquence); (अम्), n. the flower of Barleria;
the body.
—वाण-गङ्गा, f. ‘arrow Ganges,’ N. of
a river flowing past Someśa (and said to have been
produced by Rāvaṇa by cleaving a mountain with an
arrow).
—वाण-गोचर, अस्, m. the range of an
arrow.
—वाण-जित्, त्, m. ‘conqueror of the Asura
Vāṇa,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu.
—वाण-तूण, अस्, m.
‘arrow-quiver,’ a quiver.
—वाणतूणी-कृत, अस्,
आ, अम्, made into a quiver.
—वाण-धि, इस्, m.
‘arrow-receptacle,’ a quiver.
—वाण-नाशा, f., N. of
a river.
—वाण-निकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced or
wounded by an arrow.
—वाण-पञ्चानन, अस्, m.,
N. of a poet.
—वाण-पथ, अस्, m. ‘arrow-path,’
the range of an arrow, a bow-shot.
—वाणपथातीत
(˚थ-अत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, passed beyond the range of
an arrow.
—वाण-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, ‘arrow-handed,’
having arrows in the hand, armed with arrows.
—वाण-पात, अस्, m. arrow-fall, an arrow-shot (as
a measure of distance), the range of an arrow.
—वा-
णपात-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being within the range
of an arrow.
—वाण-पुङ्खा, f. the feathered end
of an arrow or that part of an arrow which includes
the feathers and shaft.
—वाण-पुर्, ऊर्, f. or वाण-
पुर, अम्, n. the capital of Vāṇa-rāja.
—वाण-
भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of an author.
—वाण-मय, अस्,
ई, अम्, consisting of arrows, arrowy.
—वाण-मुक्ति,
इस्, f. or वाण-मोक्षण, अम्, n. discharge of an
arrow, shooting an arrow.
—वाण-योजन, अम्, n.
‘arrow-union,’ a quiver.
—वाण-राज, अस्, m. ‘king-
Vāṇa,’ epithet of the Asura.
—वाण-रेखा, f. a
long wound made by an arrow.
—वाण-लिङ्ग, अम्,
n., N. of a Liṅga on the bank of the Narma-dā river.
—वाण-वर्षण, अम्, n. or वाण-वृष्टि, इस्, f.
showering down arrows or darts.
—वाण-वर्षिन्,
ई, इणि, इ, showering arrows.
—वाण-वार, अस्, m.
‘arrow-defender,’ a breastplate, cuirass, armour.
—वा-
ण-सन्धान, अम्, n. the fitting of an arrow to the
bow-string.
—वाण-सिद्धि, इस्, f. the hitting of a
mark by an arrow.
—वाण-सुता, f. ‘daughter of
Vāṇa,’ epithet of Uṣā or the Dawn (wife of Ani-
ruddha, see Uṣā).
—वाण-हन्, आ, or वाणारि (˚ण-
अरि˚), इस्, m. ‘killer or enemy of Vāṇa,’ an epithet
of Viṣṇu.
—वाणावली (˚ण-आव्˚), f. a series of five
Ślokas (containing only one sentence).
—वाणाश्रय
(˚ण-आश्˚), अस्, m. ‘arrow-receptacle,’ a quiver.
—वाणासन (˚ण-अस्˚), अम्, n. ‘arrow-discharger,’
a bow.
—वाणेश्वर (˚ण-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a
temple.

वाण 2. वाण (fr. rt. वे) for 2. वान, q. v.
—वाण-दण्ड, अस्, m. a weaver's loom (for वान-
दण्ड).

वणथलग्राम वणथल-ग्राम, अस्, m. (pro-
bably a corruption of वन-स्थल-ग्˚), N. of a
village.

वणिज् वणिज्, क्, m. (also written बणिज्,
q. v.), a merchant, trader; the sign of the zodiac
Libra or the Scales; (क्), f. trade, merchandise.
—व-
णिक्-कर्मन्, अ, n. or वणिक्-क्रिया, f. the business
or occupation of a trader, trade, merchandise.
[]
—वणिक्-पथ, अस्, m. (see बणिक्-पथ), ‘trader's
path, ‘a trader's business, merchandise, traffic; a
merchant's shop; a merchant; the zodiacal sign
Libra or the Scales.
—वणिक्-सार्थ, अस्, m. a com-
pany of traders or merchants, caravan.
—वणिग्-
जन, अस्, m. a tradesman, merchant; tradespeople,
merchants.
—वणिग्-बन्धु, वणिग्-भाव, वणिग्-
वह, see बणिग्-ब्˚, &c.
—वणिग्-वृत्ति, इस्, f. ‘live-
lihood by trade,’ trade, traffic, retail or petty trade, low
trade, huckstering.
—वणिङ्-मार्ग, अस्, m. ‘trader's
path or road,’ a merchant's shop, &c. (= विपणि).

वणिज, अस्, m. = वणिज्, a merchant; the zodiacal
sign Libra; N. of a particular Karaṇa.

वाणिज वाणिज, अस्, m. (usually spelt बा-
णिज, q. v.), a merchant.
वणिजक, अस्, m. a merchant.

वणिज्य, अम्, आ, n. f. trade, traffic, (for वाणिज्य;
cf. बणिज्य.)
वाणिज्य, अम्, n. traffic, trade, (see बाणिज्य.)

वण्ट् वण्ट् (also written बण्ट्, connected
with rt. वण्ड्), cl. 1. 10. P. वण्टति,
वण्टयति (also, according to some, वण्टापयति),
&c., to partition, apportion, share, separate, divide.

वण्ट, अस्, m. a part, portion; the handle of a sickle;
an unmarried man; (अस्, आ, अम्), unmarried.

वण्टक, अस्, m. dividing; an apportioner, distri-
buter; a part, portion, share.

वण्टन, अम्, n. the act of portioning, apportion-
ing, partitioning, dividing into shares.

वण्टनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be apportioned, divisi-
ble, to be divided.

वण्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, divided into shares, distri-
buted.

वण्टाल वण्टाल or वण्ठाल, अस्, m. a
spade, shovel, hoe; a boat; a kind of battle, the
contest of heroes; [cf. वण्डाल.]

वण्ठ् वण्ठ्, cl. 1. A. वण्ठते, ववण्ठे,
वण्ठितुम्, to go or move alone, go un-
accompanied.

वण्ठर, अस्, m. the new shoot of the Tāl or
palm tree; the sheath that envelopes the young
bamboo; a rope for tying a goat, &c.; the female
breast; a dog's tail; a dog; a cloud.

वण्ड् वण्ड् (connected with rt. वण्ट्),
cl. 1. A. वण्डते, ववण्डे, वण्डितुम्,
to partition, apportion, share, divide; to surround,
encompass; to cover; cl. 10. P. वण्डयति, &c.,
to partition, share, divide.

वण्ड वण्ड, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
1. वन् or वण्), maimed, defective, crippled (espe-
cially in the hands or feet or tail), one whose
hands have been cut off [cf. वण्ठ]; impotent,
emasculated [cf. पण्ड]; (अस्), m. a man who is
circumcised or has no prepuce, (probably a wrong
reading for चण्ड); an ox without a tail [cf. अ-वण्ड];
(आ), f. an unchaste woman, (probably a wrong reading
for रण्डा.)

वण्डर, अस्, m. a niggard, miser; a eunuch or
attendant on the women's apartments.

वण्डाल वण्डाल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
वण्ड्), a particular mode of fighting, the contest of
heroes; a boat; a spade, a hoe.

वाणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having an arrow or arrows; speak-
ing; (इनी), f. a sharp or clever woman, an intriguing
woman; an actress, dancer, Nāch girl; a drunken
woman, one literally or figuratively intoxicated.
वाणीची, f., Ved. speech or the goddess of speech.
वाणीची वाणीची. See above.

वाणि, इस्, f. weaving; a weaver's loom; a species
of the Aṣṭi metre, (also written वाणी.)
वाणी वाणी, f. See under 1. वाण, col. 1.

वाणी-वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, uttering words, talking,
talkative; (अस्), m. a kind of bird.
